notes: PROVISIONAL vendor spots in the Medieval Kingdom town (Docs/CastleTown.md), consumed by feat/vendors. Realm-local centimetres: world = local + CastleTown.json realms[team].offset.xy + frameCenter, and z = the ground under the spot (CireLanePath::ToWorld). Stored once, used by both realms (every team gets all three vendors). Each spot is at one of the pack's own market stalls near the castle, so the stall reads as that vendor's shop. Eric re-places them with the map layout editor (feat/dev-route-tools).
